name: YouTube (Data API v3 channels.list, channel RSS feed, oEmbed)
tier_rationale: Google LLC is an established company with published terms and a privacy policy (A8 trusted); P110 cond 6 'Registry provider youtube (Google): tier trusted'.

reliability.justification: Authoritative for YouTube channel ids, creation dates and public counts; channel titles and descriptions are owner-written.

youtube.description: YouTube Data API v3 key (Google Cloud project with the YouTube Data API enabled); sent as the 'key' URL parameter, masked by the central redactor (AR01). channels.list costs 1 quota unit of the 10,000 units/day default.
youtube.plan_hint: key-terms: the Data API runs under the corporate profile only once key_plans.youtube = 'business' is recorded (v3lum keys set youtube --plan business) after legal confirms the YouTube API Services terms and storage policy (P110 cond 5/6)

data_api.title: YouTube Data API v3 channels.list (forHandle=@<handle> or id=<UC...>, part=snippet,statistics; 1 quota unit)

terms.quote: Registry provider youtube (Google): tier trusted; Data API source 'key-terms' (plan recorded in key_plans), RSS and oEmbed sources 'open'; personal_data_review before default use for handle inputs (A3 BR8).

data_api.notes: Quote: binding council text (P110 cond 6). Without a key the API answers 403 PERMISSION_DENIED 'Permission denied on the service' (observed 2026-11-26 on youtube.googleapis.com and www.googleapis.com) = NEEDS_KEY; quotaExceeded = QUOTA (P110 cond 3). The dedicated service host youtube.googleapis.com (the API's discovery rootUrl) is used instead of the shared www.googleapis.com. Storage: cache_ttl <= 30 days and redacted evidence (YouTube API Services developer policies, P110 cond 5; legal confirms the reading).

rss.title: YouTube channel feed https://www.youtube.com/feeds/videos.xml?channel_id=UC... (Atom, 15 latest uploads, channel creation date)

terms.quote: Registry provider youtube (Google): tier trusted; Data API source 'key-terms' (plan recorded in key_plans), RSS and oEmbed sources 'open'; personal_data_review before default use for handle inputs (A3 BR8).

rss.notes: Quote: binding council text (P110 cond 6). Published feed interface (P110 cond 2); 404 HTML for an unknown channel id (observed); the server sends Cache-Control max-age=900. The keyless youtube.com/@handle page scrape is NOT built (P110 cond 1, legal floor).

oembed.title: YouTube oEmbed https://www.youtube.com/oembed?url=<watch URL>&format=json (video title, channel name and URL)

terms.quote: Registry provider youtube (Google): tier trusted; Data API source 'key-terms' (plan recorded in key_plans), RSS and oEmbed sources 'open'; personal_data_review before default use for handle inputs (A3 BR8).

oembed.notes: Quote: binding council text (P110 cond 6). Video URLs only, re-sent as the canonical watch URL; an unknown well-formed video id answers 400 'Bad Request' (observed 2026-11-26), 401/403 = private or not embeddable.

notes: Owned by batch p3-G05-1 (P110 youtube). One key 'youtube' (V3LUM_KEY_YOUTUBE; V3LUM_YOUTUBE_KEY and V3LUM_YOUTUBE_API_KEY are aliases only, P110 cond 3). The quota block books the Data API's 10,000 units/day per key (P334); it is provider-wide, so keyless RSS/oEmbed requests are counted too (conservative; per-source quota blocks are a core request). Consent redirects (consent.youtube.com) and Google 'sorry' pages are BLOCKED challenge, never empty (P110 cond 4).
